framework: none — plain static HTML/CSS/JS; site/ is the Netlify publish root (netlify.toml base=site, no build step)
fonts: Google Fonts CDN — Cormorant Garamond (display), IBM Plex Mono (body), VT323 (outlier), Noto Serif JP 400 text-subset (JP display companion)
palette: OKLCH custom properties in site/tokens.css — gilded-CRT custom theme (paper oklch(16.2% 0.008 67), accent oklch(70.5% 0.193 39), gold oklch(73.9% 0.101 84))
motion: no motion library — vanilla JS (starfield canvas, IntersectionObserver); prefers-reduced-motion honored
entry: site/index.html → site/style.css (@import tokens.css) + site/main.js + site/download-widget.js (synced copy of tools/download-widget/)
